title: Tech Note: Classification and Resources of External Routines (Plug-ins)

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the classification system and resource structure of 4D plug-ins (formerly called 'external routines' prior to v3.5), and explains how to handle them during database conversion to v6. The plug-in architecture has undergone major changes since this era — the 4D Plug-in SDK has evolved significantly, and many classic plug-ins have been replaced by built-in commands or the component architecture introduced in later versions.
related_updates: The 4D component architecture largely replaced the need for compiled plug-ins for many use cases
The 4D Plug-in SDK has been significantly modernized since the v6 era
Many plug-ins from this era (4D Calc, 4D Chart, 4D Draw) have been discontinued
